body:

|---|---|---|
| `flake` | applied | nixpkgs |
| `tools:oapi-codegen` | unchanged | — |
| `tools:pre-commit` | unchanged | — |
| `tools:docs` | unchanged | — |
| `gomod` | partial | update dependencies |
| `docker-go` | applied | golang builders to 1.27.2 / 1.27.1 |
| `image:alpine` | unchanged | — |
| `image:debian` | unchanged | — |
| `image:node` | unchanged | — |
| `image:rust` | applied | rust 1.98-trixie to 1.99-trixie |
| `image:distroless` | unchanged | — |
| `actions` | applied | 3 action pins |
| `generate` | unchanged | — |
| `fmt` | unchanged | — |

<details><summary>What moved</summary>

**flake**

- nixpkgs 3181085 -> 8edc0c7
- go 1.27.1
- golangci-lint has version 2.14.0 built with go1.27.1 from v2.14.0 on 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z

**gomod**

- github.com/creachadair/command v0.2.11 -> [v0.2.12](https://github.com/creachadair/command/compare/v0.2.11...v0.2.12)
- github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 v5.3.2 -> [v5.4.0](https://github.com/go-chi/chi/compare/v5.3.2...v5.4.0)
- golang.org/x/sync v0.23.0 -> v0.24.0

**docker-go**

- Dockerfile.tailscale-HEAD golang 1.27.1 -> 1.27.2 (tailscale main)
- Dockerfile.derper golang 1.27.1 -> 1.27.2 (tailscale main)

**image:rust**

- rust 1.98-trixie -> 1.99-trixie in Dockerfile.tailscale-rs

**actions**

- actions/download-artifact v8.0.1 -> v8.0.2
- actions/upload-artifact v7.0.1 -> v7.0.2
- hustcer/setup-nu v3.27 -> v3.28
- files: build.yml, container-main.yml, integration-test-template.yml, needs-more-info-timer.yml, test-integration.yaml

</details>

### Dropped

- **`tailscale`** (in `gomod`) — dependencies require a newer Go than the devShell provides: go.mod now requires go 1.27.2, the devShell provides 1.27.1
- **`sqlite`** (in `gomod`) — `nix develop --fallback --command golangci-lint run --timeout 10m` failed
